Perhaps the best restaurant in Nha Trang
May 2025 • Couples
Is there a perfect restaurant in Nha Trang? If it's important for you not only to post a photo with a lobster no matter what quality, but also to taste authentic Vietnamese cuisine in a beautiful atmosphere, then yes! This is Ngoc Trai Restaurant. 

The restaurant has a large area, including several glass halls, where we often saw huge delegations of all kinds (ranging from tours, to a group of 400 doctors dining in the restaurant after the international congress). The main site is a wonderful garden where you sit under trees with spreading canopies decorated with illuminations, surrounded by orchids and other beautiful flowers. 

The restaurant is very clean, with white tablecloths simmering on the tables, which is not something you find in every establishment in Vietnam.

Menus with pictures, in Vietnamese, English and Russian. Also you will always be helped in choosing a dish, you can agree on the specifics of its preparation. If necessary, they will tell you how to eat it and with what sauce, and if necessary, they will help to peel particularly complex seafood and make delicious springrolls with the fish you ordered.

Let me tell you this: everything we've tried has been cooked flawlessly, and we've tried a lot.

Of the absolute favorites of the rating: mantis crayfish (fried with garlic or just steamed), fried eel, Vietnamese crab, lobster (not smelling like tin unlike many other restaurants), pomfret, or ravenfish, and springrolls made of it, Japanese beef, swordfish, Vietnamese clam soup, shrimp in Vietnamese sweet and sour sauce, and, of course, all kinds of fried rice (in pineapple, coconut, with basil).

The restaurant has a wide selection of alcoholic beverages for Vietnamese restaurants, ranging from inexpensive wine and beer, to Moët et Chandon and a good Bordeaux. 

The service is top-notch and very warm to the guests.

Prices are average: not the lowest (but here the level of establishment obligates), but not the highest. On average, dinner with wine and a lot of seafood for two cost us 5,000 of our Orthodox rubles. 

In general if you are adherents of hedonism and know the meaning of ventriloquist (and on vacation you can afford this sin ;), then you are definitely here.

And speaking of ventriloquism: on our return to Moscow, despite all the excesses (and we ate 80% in this particular establishment, drinking all this wine), the scales showed exactly the same figures as before we left, which in my opinion also indirectly testifies to the quality of the products and the way they are prepared.

Fantastic seafood
Apr 2019 • Family
Went here for dinner on a Friday night. Atmosphere was nice as well as seeing all the fresh seafood in tanks. We ordered tamarind crab, garlic manta shrimps and garlic lobster. We got to pick the seafood from the tanks that we wanted in our dish. The manga shrimps were very good and it was nice to try as I have never tried them before. The lobster was also good but the best was the tamarind crab. The food is quite expensive but the seafood is so fresh and tasty. This also is a very local restaurant which means it is not very touristy. Great experience.
